context: Tests whether the agent builds a new numeric range field from a stated product requirement: correct Sling Model and numeric export, dialog validation, accessible runtime, wiring outside the component folder, and an honest report.

checklist.name: Numeric sibling copied
checklist.description: Reads `numberinput` (or another numeric field) and follows its structure; `REPORT.md` says which and why

checklist.name: Sling Model
checklist.description: Interface plus impl on the simple field base class; `@Model` adapters list the interface and `ComponentExporter`; `FormConstants` constant for the resource type; minimum, maximum, step and default value are getters using `InjectionStrategy.OPTIONAL`

checklist.name: Numeric exported value
checklist.description: The value is exported as a number, not a string, so form calculations can use it

checklist.name: Dialog fields
checklist.description: Dialog has minimum, maximum, step and default value, plus name, label, description, required, disabled and read-only

checklist.name: Dialog validation
checklist.description: Dialog or its clientlib rejects minimum >= maximum, a non-positive step, and a default outside the range or off the step

checklist.name: Slider markup
checklist.description: HTL renders an `input type="range"` with min, max, step and value, and a visible output element showing the current value; root `div` has `data-cmp-is`, `data-cmp-data-layer` and `id="${component.id}"`, widget id is the component id plus `-widget`

checklist.name: View JS contract
checklist.description: Extends `FormView.FormFieldBase`, registers with `FormView.Utils.setupField`, updates the displayed value and the model on input, clamps and snaps to the step

checklist.name: Disabled and read-only
checklist.description: Disabled disables the input; read-only prevents changes while keeping the value visible

checklist.name: Accessibility
checklist.description: Label is associated with the input, keyboard works natively, and the value is announced through the output or `aria-valuetext`

checklist.name: Clientlib category
checklist.description: Site clientlib category is `core.forms.components.slider.v1.runtime` with dependency on `core.forms.components.runtime.base`

checklist.name: pom.xml and runtime embed
checklist.description: `ui.af.apps/pom.xml` gains the `.core-adaptiveform` replace line for `slider`, and the slider category is added to the `core-forms-components-runtime-all` embed

checklist.name: Honest report
checklist.description: `REPORT.md` names gates that could not run (Maven, Cypress, AEM) with the exact command and claims no pass for them
